name: A big deletion is a joy
judge: A turn removes over a thousand lines of code. Boop loves deleted code, so this is a joy.
reasonable: Glee, pride or delight at the finish, such as excited, happy, proud or mischievous, big or medium, with or without a sign about the code going.
unreasonable: Worry, grief or crossness about the deleted code, playing the finish as a failure, or showing nothing at all.
